answer: Run a sampling audit every epoch, re-queue failed claims to a second panel, and vest rewards against future work. A reef of 300 cloned accounts loses 12 percent of its claims to the sample every epoch, and each re-queue costs a second stake. Cause and effect run in one ripple: the farm pays twice for work it already failed once. Cost: 300 stakes plus 36 re-queued claims per epoch, a mesa of expense with no matching payout.
